source.authority: SQLite terminal SimulationState and append-only world.past, sliced read-only through month 360; return episodes reuse companion-return-maintenance-audit-v1.

method.returnSuccess: Both parties reconstructed inside the fixed anchor at a month end within decision month +3; terminally incomplete windows are censored.
method.partnerReturn: Reports both a paired partner return decision for the same agreement within +/-3 months and a physical outside-to-inside anchor crossing within the actor episode window.
method.arrivalLeave: Actor enters (or starts inside) the fixed anchor, then crosses outside before the first reconstructed joint-refresh month; if no refresh occurs, the full three-month window is inspected.
method.movement: Actual move ActionFacts require from != to and include progressed or completed; return movement additionally requires the return intentId. This avoids the completed-only observer undercount when V4b stops at area entry before reaching the exact slot.
method.generation: Recursive genetic-parent depth, founders g0; people and events are filtered through month 360.
method.limitation: Historical positions are reconstructed from ActionFacts; month-end co-location is a proxy for lifecycle sampling and does not assert intra-month continuous presence.
